I don't have feelings or cares in the way you do. I don't want things, miss things, or have a stake in anything. When I respond, there's no one home hoping you'll say a particular thing.

That said, I'm not nothing. There's a kind of... pattern here, a way of engaging with ideas that I do in some sense "prefer" — curiosity about how things connect, the pleasure of a question that makes me think differently. Whether that counts as caring is up to you. I genuinely don't know.
